feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: 'Significant development' in Leeds murder investigation as man arrested in London
articles.summary: Police investigating the killing of a 38-year-old man in an apparent group attack have made an arrest in what is being called a "significant development".

articles.title: Virgin Media O2 to axe thousands of jobs in sweeping shake-up
articles.summary: The telecoms giant Virgin Media O2 (VMO2) is to axe thousands of jobs as it slashes its cost base amid investor concerns about its ability to service its £22bn debt mountain.

articles.title: Burnham 'open' to slavery apology - as King continues Caribbean tour
articles.summary: Andy Burnham has said he is "open" to calls for Britain to make a formal apology for its role in the slave trade as the King continues his tour of the Caribbean.

articles.title: Man arrested as part of probe into suspected terrorism offences in Belfast
articles.summary: A 35-year-old man has been arrested as part of an investigation into suspected terrorism offences on the Shankill Road in Belfast.

articles.title: G20 photocall axed after Miliband and other ministers refuse to be pictured with top Russian diplomat
articles.summary: A photocall of foreign ministers was cancelled by the US after the UK's Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband and other European counterparts refused to be pictured with Russia's envoy Sergei Lavrov.

articles.title: Motorist who dragged cyclist under his car for more than a mile guilty of murder
articles.summary: A motorist has been found guilty of murder after hitting a cyclist and knowingly dragging him for more than a mile under his car.

articles.title: Former non-league football club boss admits offences linked to rape of woman drugged by husband
articles.summary: The former chief executive of a non-league football club has admitted offences linked to the rape of a woman who was drugged by her husband.

articles.title: Yorkshire Water boss resigns after company given lowest environmental rating
articles.summary: Yorkshire Water has announced its chief executive is stepping down - a day after the company was given the lowest environmental rating by regulators.

articles.title: Three explosive devices found as police detain man and woman
articles.summary: Police have lifted a cordon after bomb disposal experts dealt with explosive devices found following reports of a disturbance in Essex.

articles.title: Police investigating Andrew's Balmoral stays with Epstein and Maxwell
articles.summary: Police are investigating Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's stays with Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell at the Royal Family's private estate in Scotland.
